channel.title: CareCompass: Health news
channel.description: US healthcare news and explainers: Medicare, Medicaid, ACA open enrollment, drug prices, dental coverage and cosmetic care, checked against official sources.

item.title: Medicare open enrollment for 2027: what to check before December 7
item.description: Medicare open enrollment runs Oct 15 to Dec 7, 2026. The 2027 Part D cap, deductible, Medicare Advantage changes and what to check before you switch.

item.title: ACA Marketplace open enrollment for 2027: dates and tips
item.description: HealthCare.gov open enrollment for 2027 coverage starts November 1, 2026. Deadlines, state exchange dates, rising premiums and how to compare Marketplace plans.

item.title: ACA subsidies in 2027: what the end of enhanced tax credits means
item.description: The enhanced ACA premium tax credits expired at the end of 2025. What that means for 2027 Marketplace premiums, the 400% poverty-level cliff and your options.

item.title: Free consultation checklist: 15 questions to ask
item.description: Make the most of a free dental, orthodontic or cosmetic consultation: 15 questions about costs, insurance, risks, recovery and the provider’s experience.

item.title: Medicaid work requirements: what changes in 2027
item.description: Medicaid “community engagement” requirements start by Jan 1, 2027 in expansion states. Who must report 80 hours a month, who is exempt and how to keep cover.

item.title: Compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide: what the FDA says now
item.description: The semaglutide and tirzepatide shortages are over. What that means for compounded GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, FDA warnings and safer options.

item.title: Medicare’s 2027 negotiated drug prices, explained
item.description: Medicare’s second round of negotiated drug prices, covering 15 drugs including Ozempic and Wegovy, takes effect January 1, 2027. What it means for your copays.

item.title: How to choose a plastic surgeon: a safety checklist
item.description: How to check a plastic surgeon’s board certification, license and hospital privileges, choose an accredited facility and spot red flags before cosmetic surgery.

item.title: The Medicare Part D out-of-pocket cap, explained
item.description: Medicare Part D caps what you pay for covered drugs each year: $2,100 in 2026 and $2,400 in 2027. How the cap works and how to spread costs monthly.

item.title: Medical and dental tourism: the risks to know first
item.description: Thinking of getting implants, veneers or cosmetic surgery abroad? The CDC’s advice on medical tourism, common risks, aftercare problems and questions to ask.

item.title: Med spa safety: choosing who injects your Botox and fillers
item.description: Med spa safety guide: who can inject Botox and fillers, spotting counterfeit products, questions to ask and what to do if something goes wrong.

item.title: HSA changes for 2026 and 2027: what is new
item.description: New HSA rules: bronze and catastrophic Marketplace plans now qualify, direct primary care fees can be paid from an HSA, telehealth is permanent and 2027 limits.

item.title: Medicare telehealth extended through 2027
item.description: Medicare telehealth flexibilities, including visits from home, run through December 31, 2027. What is covered and what may change next.

item.title: The No Surprises Act: protection from surprise medical bills
item.description: How the No Surprises Act stops surprise out-of-network bills for emergencies and hospital care, and how uninsured patients get a Good Faith Estimate.

item.title: Medical debt and your credit report: where things stand
item.description: The CFPB rule banning medical debt from credit reports was vacated in 2025. What protections remain, how to dispute errors and how to negotiate medical bills.

item.title: Does Medicare cover dental? Your options for 2027
item.description: Original Medicare does not cover routine dental care. How Medicare Advantage, stand-alone dental plans and savings plans can fill the gap in 2027.

item.title: Urgent care vs the ER: where should you go?
item.description: When to choose urgent care, the emergency room, telehealth or your regular doctor, what each typically costs you, and how your insurance treats each one.

item.title: How dental insurance works (and how to get the most from it)
item.description: Dental insurance explained: annual maximums, deductibles, the 100-80-50 coverage pattern, waiting periods, missing tooth clauses and pre-treatment estimates.

item.title: Dental savings plans vs dental insurance
item.description: Dental savings (discount) plans and dental insurance compared: how each works, waiting periods, annual maximums, in-house membership plans and who each suits.

item.title: Hospital price transparency: how to find real prices
item.description: Hospitals must publish their prices online. What the 2026 price transparency changes require, how to look up shoppable services and use prices to save money.

item.title: Free and low-cost dental care: where to look
item.description: No dental insurance? Where to find free and low-cost dental care in the US: community health centers, dental schools, Medicaid, free clinic events and more.

item.title: Clear aligners vs braces: which is right for you?
item.description: Clear aligners vs metal and ceramic braces compared for teens and adults: effectiveness, comfort, appearance, treatment time, cost factors and insurance.

item.title: Kids’ dental care: first visits, CHIP and coverage
item.description: When should your child first see a dentist? How Medicaid, CHIP and Marketplace plans cover children’s dental care, sealants, fluoride and orthodontics.

item.title: The water fluoridation debate: where things stand
item.description: Utah and Florida ended community water fluoridation in 2025 and other states are debating it. What changed, what dentists say and how to protect your teeth.
